Only access/permit proposed. Stored grade 5.11c/d, length_m 27 (MP 90 ft, 27 m) and pitches 1 (not stated; one 90 ft length) agree with MP; one source, unchanged, no lock. No safety warnings on the page.

wa_northwest_face_cornercopia.notes: Stored length_m 35 verified: Mountain Project states 115 ft (35 m); one source, unchanged, no lock (not on theCrag's sector). Stored grade 5.9 and trad match MP. Pitches 1 not stated (one 115 ft length to the upper anchor); unchanged. Bolts not proposed: MP mentions a camouflaged bolt early and one more later and a piton replaced by a bolt, but states no count. FA is blank: MP gives Wayne Wallace, 1980s (gear and one piton), rebolted and extended to a higher anchor in October 2023 by Topher Dabrowski and Mark Deffenbaugh; one source, not filled. Descent needs a 70 m rope; with a 60 m rope, rappel to the Charted Waters top anchor first. Starts behind the water spigot, right of the brass plaque. The line was extended in 2023, so older guide lengths may be shorter.

held.why: HELD: Mountain Project states 3 pitches (P1 5.9 30 m 10 bolts, P2 5.8 25 m 5 bolts, P3 5.10a 35 m 7 bolts). One source; a one-source change to a non-zero pitch count is held (brief AF: change neither value on one source). No second publisher found (not on theCrag's sector; two web searches found nothing else).

HELD: Stored 11 m is impossible against any source (P1 alone is 30 m). But Mountain Project contradicts itself: the header says 250 ft (76 m) while its pitch lengths add to 90 m (295 ft), which matches MP's own Genesis page (300 ft, 91 m) whose P3 Winters Passage shares. Self-contradicting single source, so no new value is proposed; the owner may want 11 -> null.
HELD: Mountain Project types it Sport (all pitches bolted, optional 0.5 / ~1 in cam). Discipline never changes on one source.

disputed: length_m: stored 11; Mountain Project header 250 ft (76 m); MP's own pitch lengths 30 + 25 + 35 = 90 m (295 ft); MP Genesis page 300 ft (91 m) for the line sharing P3.
wa_northwest_face_winters_passage.notes: OVERLAP: P3 (5.10a, 35 m, 7 bolts, to a big Douglas fir) is the same pitch as Genesis P3 (wa_genesis), and P2 ends at the anchor Genesis uses (MP Genesis: bolted belay at Big Tree Ledge). P1 is its own line just right of Genesis. Not a duplicate. FA is blank: MP gives Gordon Mertz, winter 2000-2001; one source, not filled. A photo caption on MP says most bolts were removed and replaced (rebolted); no detail. Descent: rappel from the tree to an intermediate anchor on climber's left, then the shared Genesis anchor, then two more raps. Nothing proposed beyond access/permit.
